lead_headline: Metaflow closes five issues in a quiet overnight window; Claude Code accumulates noise
lead_body: Metaflow was the only tracked project to move on May 10, merging four PRs just after 03:00 UTC and closing five issues alongside them. The closures included a genuine longstanding gap: the @catch decorator's inability to wrap foreach split steps. Claude Code opened eight issues across the day — a Bun GC segfault, prompt-cache bleed in subagents, and several feature requests — but nothing merged.
lead_article:
The only project that moved today was Metaflow, and it moved cleanly. Four PRs merged in a tight window just after 03:00: a typo-and-syntax cleanup in the Cards UI, removal of the now-redundant `_sfn_host_network` variable that had been hardcoded to `False` in the Tiltfile, a workflow concurrency update to reduce runner contention, and a small README correction adding the missing Airflow dependency note. Five issues closed alongside, including a real one — the `@catch` decorator's inability to wrap `foreach` split steps, a longstanding error-handling gap that had no clean workaround. The `@timeout` Windows crash via SIGALRM also closed, as did a subprocess race condition that was leaving orphaned processes after timeout or SIGINT.

Claude Code generated noise but no signal — eight issues opened across the day, ranging from a Bun 1.3.14 GC segfault on AMD Ryzen hardware to a subagent prompt-cache bleed problem where child agents were inheriting roughly 150K tokens of parent context and developing plan-mode contamination. The iOS session-mirroring feature request and the user-configurable autocompact threshold are both reasonable asks, but nothing merged and nothing closed. The rest of the tracked projects were quiet.
